exposure: accelerated weight gain (AWG) after postnatal slow weight gain (PSWG)
cohort: This study included 255 subjects born at term, appropriate for gestational age, and with normal birth weight, who experienced postnatal slow weight gain until 3-4 months of age.
finding: Accelerated weight gain immediately after postnatal slow weight gain, particularly between 6-9 and 17-20 months, significantly increased the risk of overweight status at 3 years of age.
